podcast.body: Gilbert O'Sullivan released "Alone Again Naturally" in 1972. This song was later sampled without authorization by Biz Markie, leading to a significant lawsuit in 1991 that forced the withdrawal of Markie's album from the marketplace. "In 1991 when Gilbert O'Sullivan sued Biz Markey for an unauthorized sample of his 1972 song, Alone Again Naturally."
